name: Stripe payments
shortDescription: The payment element of the node. It is meant to take card payments through the owner's own Stripe account for the other elements of the node, so they need no payment code and no Stripe keys of their own. It is installed and turned off: card payments are not built yet.
longDescription:
Stripe payments is a native element of the node. It is meant to be the one place that holds the owner's Stripe keys and talks to Stripe. An element that sells something asks it for a payment link and later for the payment status, and never touches a card or a key. Payments go through Stripe Checkout, the payment page on Stripe's side, so no card number reaches the node.

Today it is a body only: the node installs it, knows it and keeps it turned off. The checkout, the payment status, the Stripe webhook and the list of payments come in the next steps of the node. Turning it on today starts the template site and nothing else.
accepts: Nothing yet: card payments are not built and the element is turned off by default.

reason.en: Card payments are not built yet
